text:
maria: quick heads-up: planning to publish py/sdk 1.4.0 and ts sdk 0.9.3 in the late change window (22:00 UTC). main blocker is wheel signing and npm tag policy. want a quick sync.
jonathan: thanks. what's the pin strategy for downstream users? do we pin the legacy sync client?
maria: we'll publish final packages and create 'stable' tag. also push a deprecation note in release notes for legacy sync. @samir can you confirm signing keys are ready?
samir: keys good. will run signing pipeline at T-10. we use internal cosign + HSM. command I'll run: `cosign sign --key /hsm/redwood.pem dist/*.whl`
ashley: QA update: canary matrix passed on 3 apps. small failing case for ts sdk ESM import in one internal repo. suggestion: publish TS as both cjs & esm and add `exports` map.
jonathan: ok on ESM fix, thanks. if we can't ship both formats, what's our rollback criteria?
maria: rollback rules: 1) publish fails integrity/signature mismatch 2) canary success <90% 3) critical import break in main customer app. proposal: pin previous version as `stable` before canary so rollback is a simple retag.
samir: yes we can tag 1.3.8 as `stable` now and keep `latest` for the canary. rollback plan: retag `latest` -> 1.3.8 and unpublish 1.4.0 from npm/pypi if needed.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: py-sdk v1.4.0 (canary) -> pool: canary, started by maria. Build #6789. status: running.
release-bot: Release notes draft created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SDK-RELEASE-203. Add deprecation line: `legacy sync client (sync.*) deprecated 2026-06-30`
ashley: adding ESM import smoke to the release checklist. also adding internal pip install line for QA: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.4.0 --index-url https://packages.redwood/internal`
jonathan: @maria if signing pipeline fails can we re-sign and reupload the same version or do we have to bump the patch?
maria: prefer reupload with same version only if artifact hasn't been pulled by customers. if signatures leaked or artifacts distributed, bump patch (1.4.1). err conservative.
samir: signature job finished ok. cosign digest: `sha256:abc123def456...`
deploy-bot: Build #6789 succeeded. Publishing to PyPI (canary).
deploy-bot: Publish succeeded: py-sdk 1.4.0 (canary). npm publish queued for ts-sdk 0.9.3.
ashley: Canary report: 12/12 smoke apps ok, ESM import test passed. :tada:
jonathan: thanks team. i'll update SDK migration guide and add enterprise pin instructions (how to pin to `stable` + rollback steps).
maria: final call: proceed to full rollout at 23:30 UTC if no regressions. keep this thread as the rollback channel. :thumbsup:
